name: White Coffee
description: A smooth, creamy coffee with a touch of milk and a delicate latte art on top. Our most loved classic.

name: Milk Coffee
description: Rich espresso blended with warm steamed milk and a light, velvety foam. Soft, comforting and perfectly balanced.

name: Chocolate Coffee
description: Bold coffee meets dark chocolate in a sweet and indulgent cup, finished with a creamy foam.

name: Menthe Coffee
description: A refreshing twist on coffee, with a hint of fresh mint that keeps every sip light and smooth.

name: Hot Coffee
description: Our signature hot coffee, brewed fresh and topped with heart-shaped latte art. Served steaming hot.

name: Black Coffee
description: Pure, strong and full of character. Freshly brewed from selected beans, with no milk and no sugar.

name: Ginger Coffee
description: A warming blend of coffee and fresh ginger with a gentle spicy kick. Perfect on a cool morning.

name: Coffee Seed
description: Made from whole roasted coffee beans, ground and brewed to order for a deep, aromatic flavor.

name: Iced Latte
description: Espresso poured over cold milk and ice. Smooth, creamy and refreshing on a hot day.

name: Cold Brew
description: Coffee steeped slowly in cold water for a naturally sweet, low-acid taste. Served over ice.

name: Orange Juice
description: Fresh oranges squeezed to order, with no added sugar. Bright, tangy and full of vitamins.

name: Strawberry Smoothie
description: Ripe strawberries blended with creamy yogurt and ice into a thick, fruity and refreshing smoothie.

name: Hot Chocolate
description: Rich, velvety chocolate melted into hot milk. A cozy treat for chocolate lovers of all ages.

name: Green Tea
description: Light and fresh green tea leaves, gently steeped. A calm, refreshing cup with a clean finish.

name: Ginger Tea
description: Fresh ginger infused in hot water, with a warm, spicy taste. Soothing and full of flavor.

name: Honey Milk
description: Warm milk lightly sweetened with natural honey. Gentle and comforting, perfect before bedtime.

name: Croissant
description: A golden, buttery croissant with a flaky crust and a soft center. Baked fresh every morning.

name: Chocolate Muffin
description: A soft, moist muffin loaded with chocolate chips. The perfect partner for your coffee.

name: Cheesecake
description: Creamy cheesecake on a crunchy biscuit base, topped with a sweet berry sauce. Served chilled.

name: Brownie
description: A dense, fudgy chocolate brownie with a crisp top and a melt-in-your-mouth center.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Toasted bread layered with chicken, fresh lettuce, tomato and creamy sauce. Hearty and satisfying.

name: Pancakes
description: A stack of fluffy pancakes topped with butter and golden syrup. A sweet way to start the day.

name: Omelette
description: A light, fluffy omelette made with fresh eggs and herbs, served with golden potatoes.

name: Waffle
description: A crispy golden waffle drizzled with rich chocolate sauce. Crunchy outside, soft inside.
